instruction: Set up automatic screen brightness changes based on the surrounding light conditions.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic screen brightness adjustment via GNOME settings. The setup disables ambient-enabled, and the agent must enable it using gsettings command. The evaluator verifies the setting is enabled by reading the gsettings value.
metadata.verification: The evaluator uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Expected output is 'true\n' when the setting is enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically and logically correct
Getter (vm_command_line) correctly reads the ambient-enabled gsettings value that the instruction requires
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares the result against expected value 'true\n'
Expected value 'true\n' is correct - matches gsettings output format when the setting is enabled
Complete coverage - instruction has one requirement (enable ambient light adjustment) and evaluator verifies exactly this
State is always accessible - gsettings doesn't require UI/dialog state, no postconfig needed
